XXI, 1</cite>) <he>אין לך ע׳ קשה יותר מן העי׳ הזה … ומכסיף וכ׳</he> there is no wind more vehement than that which comes from the north and rises and makes pale the creatures in the south.—Pl. <he>עִלְעוֹלִין</he>, <cite ref="P00072"><he>עִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1:4">Koh. R. to VII, 1</cite> [read:] <he>כמה ע׳ היא מזדווגת</he> how many storms the ship may encounter.
